take_homes: If every step is only a bit wrong, the end result is mostly wrong. Ten steps at 85% gives about 20% right.
Asking the AI "are you sure?" does not check anything. You need a separate check.
You can have the AI test several ways of checking and keep the one that finds the most errors.
